# 3D Rot. (Direct)

[All examples](index.md) · [Document profile](../reference/studio-draft-examples.md)

With x = 1.0, y = 2.0, z = 3.0, direction_cosines = 3 x 3 array, Run displays x_out = 2.0, y_out = -1.0, z_out = 3.0, error = 0.

## What this example demonstrates

With x = 1.0, y = 2.0, z = 3.0, direction_cosines = 3 x 3 array, Run displays x_out = 2.0, y_out = -1.0, z_out = 3.0, error = 0.
